current_boundaries.fact: Readback sessions are invocation-local, bounded to eight entries, clear on BaseException and outer exit, and return copies. Every eligible reuse samples byte/directory/tool/live-code/PRL witnesses twice.
Explicit or marked private Improve children and Native7 pruning parents currently bypass session storage. No current parent-cache false acceptance is demonstrated.

_readback_witness includes evidence/source byte and directory census plus evidence PRL flags/link-count/type; it omits directory device/inode/UID and non-PRL regular-file ownership/single-link authority.

Parent reconstruction independently derives source scope, saved preferences, exact tools/code and retained definition; Context binds captured parent dev/inode and exact typed owner plus owned single-link source/snapshot/code files. This is definition/readback authority, never a live execution Budget.

existing_test_reuse.reuse: Existing copied-return/session-exit, same-size source/report/code mutation, empty-directory, symlink/FIFO, live callable/policy change, late tool callback/PRL and failed-first/exception/entry-bound controls.
Actual-shaped nested GUI parent; wrong inode/foreign owner/source; exact typed owner; private child never ordinary-cached; final Context then metadata checks.

Source-derived reconstruction, marker/definition deletion, Default basis, final all-root fence ordering and bounded failed-trial census. Fixture explicitly stubs Native and source preflight; do not label Native qualification.
Single-selection retained incumbent/protected copper, incomplete/wrong trial ancestry, source population/compute census and actual primitive guard dispatch.
Private authority module policy/callable identity; unsupported mutable policy fails closed.

limits: No implementation, test, profile or Native execution was performed. Profile timing is parent-supplied context, not independently measured here.
Pure memo must not cache file reads/stat/validation receipts or remove any semantic/terminal fence; immutable AST storage plus fresh thaw/clone is one bounded option, not a mandated architecture.
No wall/CPU cap increase, parent/child capability widening, historical result promotion, cohort retry/stitching, GUI qualification or routing-gain claim.

parent_semantic_reuse_only_if_still_purs.case: Warm an actually constructed owned Native7 parent, rename its parent directory and replace it at the same canonical path with identical bytes/directories. A second check must refuse or fully reconstruct and refuse the changed dev/inode, never hit by byte equality. Repeat changed owner UID and same-byte hardlinked source/code, plus symlink/foreign owner cases. Preserve exact bool/int and inode int/float owner distinctions.

Reuse tests must include complete parent -> exact private incumbent -> single-selection trials -> final candidate ancestry. Cover no-improvement return, selected improvement, quality/DRC rejected and incomplete trials. Mutate unselected/rejected trial receipts, proposals/base hashes, worker journals, candidate/report bindings, selected metrics or exact trial census; coherent receipt rehashing cannot hide semantic changes.

After warming, delete sidecar/markers together or mix comparison/unsupported single-policy authority, stale preferences/source, changed captured code/tools, or missing inherited Default basis. Detection must not downgrade to ordinary/legacy. An explicit private child Context remains uncached and cannot mint a Budget or authorize Route through a cached parent.

Keep own parent/incumbent/every completed trial Native, field-present/no-field, Default and process checks. After all tool/material/Context callbacks, replay shared all-root PRL metadata last on every return, including hits. Fault PRL flags/nlink in an unselected trial and mutate via a late callback between witnesses; reject and clear entries.

Unaccepted/cancelled/diagnostic/stale or first-failed results never populate; nested handled error/cancellation clears. Exercise 18 and maximum 32 trial census under unchanged resource bounds. A call-count optimization test alone is not proof of parent acceptance or bounded review performance.

pure_parse_memo_tests.case: Actual unchanged text derives once within one explicit operation, but returns equal independent nested mutable lists each time. Mutate/remove/reorder a returned subtree and atom; later hits and the first separately retained result remain unaffected. New operation derives again; nested sessions share only their intended lifetime.

Use current exact tokenizer grammar: quoted escaped quote/backslash, semicolon in quoted text, Unicode, comments/whitespace, empty sublists, unknown atoms and atom order survive uncached-vs-hit comparison byte-for-byte at token level. Different exact text (even equivalent whitespace/comment forms) does not alias a raw-text key.

Warm a valid text, then lower MAX_BYTES below its UTF-8 size: the hit must still reject under the current limit. Include multibyte input. Replace TOKEN with changed pattern/flags and replace/change the uncached parser callable/code/defaults/kwdefaults: no stale AST may be reused. Unsupported or oversized identity signatures bypass memo without changing original parser acceptance/refusal.

Malformed token gaps, unfinished quotes/escape, unmatched parenthesis, multiple roots, atom outside root and both sides of the existing nesting boundary match the old parser exactly, including its current >128 stack condition. Errors are never cached. A handled parse error or KeyboardInterrupt clears operation entries; the next valid call actually derives.

Exercise exact entry/raw-byte/AST-node/retained-atom-byte bounds with many small inputs and one large legal tree. Evict or bypass rather than add a new parser refusal when memo capacity is exhausted; oversized legal AST parses uncached. Bound both raw text and retained AST/container overhead, not raw bytes alone. Do not retain exception/traceback objects.

With memo warm, sx.read must still read files each time and enforce current file-size limit. Equal-length source/candidate/report changes, missing/symlink files, source rules changes, altered owner/link metadata, tool/captured-code/Context/Default-basis faults and late PRL mutation must still reach existing semantic/terminal refusals; only tokenization is reused.

Keep old semantics for input types not safely represented by an exact immutable memo key by deriving uncached; do not silently accept/normalize non-string inputs or add type refusals solely for caching. Count actual uncached parser calls with a stable counting seam, not a mock of the entire validation reader.

recommendation: Prefer bounded operation-local memoization of pure sexpr.parse derivation over Native7 parent semantic reuse. Keep current parent/private-child cache exclusions and all filesystem, source, tool, owner, lineage, validation and final PRL checks. Actual cap improvement remains unmeasured until lead replay/qualification.
